easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.
